mapper.insert: insert into family_member(elder_id, name, id_num, phone, email, address, relation, receive_flag, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{elderId}, #{name}, #{idNum}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, #{relation}, #{receiveFlag}, '0', #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from family_member where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
select * from family_member where elder_id = #{elderId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc
